plan.purpose: For someone who just ran a receipt or bill through extraction and wants to check, at a glance, who they paid, when, and how much, then the details they would copy into their books.
plan.title: Your invoices, read and sorted
plan.composition: A single full-width column that reads like a compact ledger. A ResultHeader opens the page with the h1 and the host's actions. Below it, the page repeats over /result: each invoice is one flat, unboxed entry, separated from the next by a Separator. Each entry starts with a small accent eyebrow (the date in words, beside a Badge for bill or receipt), then the vendor as an h2 and the one-line description. The figure people look for first comes next: a band of three Metrics with the total first and largest-left, then net and tax. Under the figures, a 2:1 Split puts the document's reference details on the left and the buyer and the reason for the classification on the right, as hairline Detail lines that hide themselves when empty, so sparse receipts stay short. The raw extracted text is a machine-level artefact and is folded away in a Collapsible at the foot of each entry. No currency unit is shown because the state carries none.

regions.purpose: Names the result and carries the host's download and share actions. It is the page's only h1.
elements: ResultHeader: eyebrow "Invoice extraction", title "Your invoices, read and sorted", muted line "Totals, tax and the details worth keeping, taken from each document."

regions.purpose: One entry per extracted invoice, repeated over the list, so one receipt or many read the same way. The identity line comes first so each entry is recognisable before its numbers.
regions.container: Stack (vertical, repeated over /result; a Separator after each item)
elements: Stack (horizontal, gap small): DateText value $item issue_date, format "weekday", tone accent; Badge text $item category/category

regions.purpose: The figures inside each entry: what was paid comes first, then how it splits into net and tax. No unit, since the result carries no currency.
regions.container: Grid (3 columns, inside the repeated item)
elements: Metric label "Total paid", value $item amount_incl_tax, format decimal
Metric label "Before tax", value $item amount_excl_tax, format decimal
Metric label "Tax", value $item vat_amount, format decimal

regions.purpose: Each entry's record details, split by who they describe: the document and the seller on the left, the buyer and the classification on the right. Empty lines hide themselves.
elements: Left: Stack of Detail lines - Detail label "Invoice no." value $item invoice_number; Detail label "Reference" value $item invoice_id; Detail label "Time" value $item time; Detail label "Seller address" value $item vendor_address; Detail label "SIRET" value $item vendor_siret; Detail label "VAT number" value $item vendor_vat_number; MthdsResult path "vat_rates" (label "VAT rates")

Right: Stack of Detail lines - Detail label "Billed to" value $item company_name; Detail label "Buyer address" value $item company_address; Detail label "Why this type" value $item category/explanation

regions.purpose: The raw text read from the document, folded away at the end of each entry for anyone who wants to check the extraction against the source.
regions.container: Collapsible (trigger "Show the original text", closed by default, inside the repeated item)

delegated: vat_rates (relative to each item of /result) - a list of numbers with no text form for TextList, so the kernel renders it
text (relative to each item of /result) - multi-line raw text that is best rendered by the kernel, inside the fold

brief:
# Result page: invoice_extraction.process_invoice

Process relevant information from an invoice

## Frame

This page is the result page of an app that is composed, then shows its result: what the person sees after one run. The host draws what surrounds it: the band with the team's logo and the app's name, then a bar restating the request with a way back to edit it and to run again. The host also owns the actions on the result, such as downloading or sharing it, and places them where the page's header puts them. There is no side panel, no app bar and no footer to build, and nothing restates the request.

The page is the result across the full width. It opens on its header, which names the result in a person's words, read from the result itself where it can be (the page's h1). Then the figure or the fact a person looks for first, then the body of the result in the shape it naturally has: a plan day by day, options side by side to compare, a record's details. Lay out what a person reads; leave out what only a machine would.

Show each value once: a figure a component already states, such as the total inside a ProportionBar, is not repeated beside it. When the result carries the request back - the same facts the person entered, such as the topic or the tone they chose - leave that part out: the host's bar already restates the request. Write a value as a person reads it: a date in words, an amount beside its currency when the result has one.

## State

The host loads the run's result under `/result` before the page renders. Read every value with `$state`; emit no `/state` patches. Paths:

- `/result` — list of structure invoice_extraction.Invoice — `output`: Invoice information extracted from text, supporting both formal bills and receipts
  - each item is a structure invoice_extraction.Invoice (Invoice information extracted from text, supporting both formal bills and receipts), with these members (paths relative to one item, for DataTable columns or $item):
    - `invoice_id` — text — `invoice_id`: Unique identifier for the invoice
    - `invoice_number` — text — `invoice_number`: Invoice number as shown on the document
    - `issue_date` — date — `issue_date`: Date when the invoice was issued
    - `time` — text — `time`: Time of the transaction if available
    - `amount_incl_tax` — number — `amount_incl_tax`: Total amount including taxes
    - `amount_excl_tax` — number — `amount_excl_tax`: Net amount excluding taxes
    - `vat_amount` — number — `vat_amount`: Total VAT/tax amount
    - `vat_rates` — list of number — `vat_rates`: List of VAT rates applied
      - each item is a number
    - `vendor` — text — `vendor`: Name of the vendor/seller
    - `vendor_address` — text — `vendor_address`: Complete address of the vendor
    - `vendor_siret` — text — `vendor_siret`: SIRET number of the vendor (French company registration)
    - `vendor_vat_number` — text — `vendor_vat_number`: VAT registration number of the vendor
    - `company_name` — text — `company_name`: Name of the purchasing company
    - `company_address` — text — `company_address`: Address of the purchasing company
    - `description` — text — `description`: Description of goods or services purchased
    - `category` — structure invoice_extraction.InvoiceDetails — `category`: Category or type of expense
      - `category/category` — choice of "bill" | "receipt" — `category`: The category of the invoice
      - `category/explanation` — text — `explanation`: Explanation of the classification
    - `text` — text — `text`: Raw text extracted from the invoice

## Delegated

None. `MthdsResult` remains available for any structure you choose not to lay out.

## One real run, as loaded

The state of one actual run, so you can judge magnitudes and lengths. Bind to the paths; do not copy these values into the spec.
